subject.title: marketplace-crons: TodoColeccion entra en rate limit en create y el circuit breaker corta el lote

question: For TodoColeccion create-side 429s, should the products flow reduce throughput with a provider-safe lock/rate limiter, split create out of `/api/todoColeccion`, or keep the current abort-and-recover behavior with stronger alerting?
rationale: The code can be changed narrowly, but the correct fix depends on the desired throughput versus provider-limit tradeoff and whether product writes should be serialized across cron invocations.

options.title: Add products write throttling
options.body: Implement a TodoColeccion products-scope limiter or lock with tests and phase metrics so create/updatePrice cannot exceed the provider's safe write envelope.

options.title: Split create into its own cron
options.body: Move create-side TodoColeccion writes to a separate route or schedule so rate limits do not consume the main sync cron budget.

options.title: Keep abort-and-recover
options.body: Accept the current batch abort behavior and improve alerting/reporting instead of reducing throughput in code.

recommendation.title: Add products write throttling
recommendation.body: Implement a TodoColeccion products-scope limiter or lock with tests and phase metrics so create/updatePrice cannot exceed the provider's safe write envelope.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent contributor across the TodoColeccion API error-handling and recovery code touched by the likely fix.
